title: Concept: Missing Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy response header
description: No Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy was sent. The document stays outside cross-origin isolation: cross-origin resources are not gated by an explicit opt-in and isolation-gated APIs stay unavailable. Whether that matters depends on what the document embeds, so the finding is a hardening gap rather than a confirmed exposure.
risk: No cross-origin isolation; isolation-gated features unavailable and embedding not gated by an explicit opt-in; LOW severity.
